title: Brent offered Secret Agent Man by Barry Sonnenfeld
summary: Brent Friedman tells of Brent offered Secret Agent Man by Barry Sonnenfeld, about late 1990s at Los Angeles, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: years later, I'm offered a job on a show with Barry Senfeld as the executive producer called Secret Agent Man.

plain: A Hollywood writer named Brent Friedman, speaking to a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in an episode about Hollywood, the CIA and UFOs, says that in the late 1990s in Los Angeles he was offered a job on a TV show called Secret Agent Man. He says its executive producer, the person overseeing the show, was the filmmaker Barry Sonnenfeld. He tells it as one link in his own path through spy and UFO themed entertainment.
